attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives one sentence and a distich and nothing else: no year, no emperor, no place beyond the epithet «ο Ρωμαίος» that the day's line carries, and no companions. The corpus keeps no Salonas. No hymn, no relics.
